items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: We worked at Shelly’s Mannehole and opposite Shelly and his men, it was a lot of fun

ctx.x: Kenny Burrell — you guys had a number of good years, huh?

Had a lot of fun. We traveled coast to coast driving. In those days we didn’t fly, we drove. And usually everyone in the group, it was usually a quartet, and everybody would drive you know. It was a lot of driving. But all the instruments and the luggage, drums, bass, everything, in a station wagon. And we’re driving coast to coast, but we didn’t drive straight through because there were a lot of places in between, like we’d stop in Kansas City, Oklahoma City, and even in Texas at a few jazz clubs. So it wasn’t a…
You’ve gone through your whole life as a musician. That’s saying something.
